Dialogs.Dialog: ...Can't you tell？ You've been a bit cold lately.
Forget playing along. Take this seriously.
(Man, she's in a really bad mood today. I guess I have been a bit cold lately...)
I'm really sorry, I won't do it again!
Don't worry about it so much!
...Aren't you the one in the wrong here？
I can't help it. I'm your girlfriend...
...Just this once. Only this once, so don't push your luck.
I know, I know. I've learned my lesson!
(She forgave me, right？ I feel like she's still not totally convinced, though...)
Don't 'what's up' me. What kind of boyfriend have you been lately？
Uh... Are you in a bad mood？
What's bad isn't my mood, it's your attitude.
(She's serious... I guess I have been a bit cold lately...)
I'm really sorry, I won't do it again!
Don't worry about it so much!
...Aren't you the one in the wrong here？
Ugh, no. I just can't let this go!
Why？ Come on, it's no big deal.
It is a big deal, idiot!
No way. I won't forgive you.
I won't... I don't want to forgive you, but ugh... I forgive you.
I forgive you! That's what you want, right...？
(She forgave me, right？ I feel like she's still not totally convinced, though...)
Maybe I'm imagining things. I feel like you've been cold to me lately.
Huh...？ Uh, aren't you just imagining things？
Please. Give me a real answer this time.
(She seems serious... I guess I have been a bit cold lately...)
I'm really sorry, I won't do it again!
Don't worry about it so much!
...Aren't you the one in the wrong here？
Because this uneasy feeling won't go away...
...It can't be helped, huh. When you date for a long time, these things happen.
Yeah. Stuff like this happens. So let it go this time, okay？
Fine... I guess it can't be helped.
(She forgave me, right？ I feel like she's still not totally convinced, though...)
(Oh, ▲小早川＊▲... I wonder if she's still mad？)
Ask her to go home together
(She might still be mad, so I'll pass...)
(Oh, ▲小早川＊▲... I wonder if she's still mad？)
Ask her to go home together
(She might still be mad, so I'll pass...)
(Oh, ▲小早川＊▲... I wonder if she's still mad？)
Ask her to go home together
I'm still not in the mood for that.
(She might still be mad, so I'll pass...)
▲小早川＊▲. Hey, let's go on a date.
▲小早川＊▲. Hey, let's go on a date...
▲小早川＊▲. Hey, let's go on a date.
No. I don't want to go.
(My phone... Oh, ▲小早川＊▲. Is she not mad anymore？)
Hey, about that date we had planned.
(My phone... Oh, ▲小早川＊▲. Is she not mad anymore？)
That date we planned. It's off.
Anyway, that's all I called to say.
(My phone... Oh, ▲小早川＊▲. Is she not mad anymore？)
Hey, you remember the date we have coming up, right？
I see. Well, I want to cancel it. Bye.
▲小早川＊▲. Hey, can we meet up right now？
I can't meet you now. Or ever again. ...Maybe.
▲小早川＊▲. Hey, can we meet up right now？
▲小早川＊▲. Hey, can we meet up right now？
Trying so hard. You look like an idiot.
Even at a time like this, you don't slack off, huh.
Wish you'd use some of that motivation on...
Well, good for you, I guess.
(Oh, it's ▲小早川＊▲... Wonder if she's still mad？)
(I should leave her alone for now.)
(Oh, it's ▲小早川＊▲... Wonder if she's still mad？)
(I should leave her alone for now.)
(Oh, it's ▲小早川＊▲... Wonder if she's still mad？)
(I should leave her alone for now.)
I have nothing to say to you.
Yeah, I know. You've been trying so hard.
Because it was rough not being able to talk to you properly, ▲小早川＊▲.
It's fine already. Let's stop doing this. I hate it.
Yeah. Guess we're making up, then.
You've been trying way too hard. Not that I mind.
Yeah, I just wanted you to forgive me, ▲小早川＊▲...
You go way overboard. Just do things right the first time.
You're right. I learned my lesson.
It's fine. I got you back plenty. ...Even if I had to push myself to do it.
Ugh, you idiot. Don't think this means I've forgiven you.
I saw. You did all that for me.
Yeah, I wanted to make up with you as soon as I could, ▲小早川＊▲.
Yeah, thanks. I was at my limit, too.
Obviously. How could I not be lonely？
I'm sorry. I won't put you through that again.
Huh？ Why are you... Um, come in.
I came to check on you. Been a good girl？
"A good girl"？ You just show up out of nowhere...
I'm much better now. I was bored, so it's good timing.
Sorry for staying so long. I should get going.
That's not what I meant. But thanks, anyway.
Oh, you look like you're doing pretty well.
Yeah, well. Coming to visit is making a big deal of it.
You're not bothering me. ...Thanks for coming by.
(She's unusually honest... Is it because she's sick？)
It's fine once in a while. I really was a bit happy.
It's getting late. I'll head out, but can I come again？
You don't have to ask every time.
Got it. See you later. Get well soon.
Huh？ D-don't come in! ...Okay, come in.
How are you doing？ Are you okay？
Yeah, I'm much better now. I was getting bored.
Yeah. ...Hehe, you came to see me, huh？
Of course I did. I was worried about you.
I should get going soon. It's bad if I stay too long.
I don't want you to go.
I can't really do that. Get yourself better first.
Okay... Will you come by again？
Yeah. So just hang in there for today, okay？ See ya.
Yeah, well, it's not like you can leave your room.
Come on, do something. Go talk my mom into it.
Don't be difficult. You seem fine, sure, but you're still sick.
Hey, you've come to visit me a lot. Got nothing better to do？
I'd come even if I didn't have free time.
Your face is red. Are you okay？
Ugh, shut up! Take a hint, will you？
Hey, are you really that worried about me？ Do you want me to get better soon？
Hehe, I just felt like asking.
▲小早川＊▲. Are you all better now？
You're making a big deal out of nothing. It was just a cold.
It'd be bad if it got worse. Just let me be happy for you.
Guess I can't stop you. Such a worrywart of an old man.
▲小早川＊▲. Are you all better now？
Can't you tell just by looking？
Haha, true. You're completely back to normal.
Also, well... thanks for coming to visit me.
Hm？ Oh, don't sweat it. I'm just glad you're better.
Don't just brush it off. It made me really happy.
▲小早川＊▲. Are you all better now？
Yeah. I bet it's because you came to visit me.
Haha, really？ Well, you did stay put and rest, ▲小早川＊▲.
Well yeah, I wanted to hang out again as soon as possible.
Right! We can do whatever we want now!
Yeah, well... First, just something with you, okay？
(I'm so bored... I'm tired of just sitting around at home.)
Yep, I came to check on you. I am your girlfriend, after all.
Thanks for coming all the way to my place.
You're the sick one here. Stop worrying about me.
Haha, fair point. Still, I'm glad you came. I was bored.
Oh, look at the time. I should probably get going.
You can stay longer, you know？
I'd like to, but... I don't want you getting worse because of me.
Get better soon, okay？ You're not the only one bored because you're sick.
(I need to get better soon, for ▲小早川＊▲'s sake too.)
(I'm so bored... I'm tired of just sitting around at home.)
You surprised me. I didn't expect you to come.
What's that supposed to mean？ Is it really so surprising？
Not like that, it was just out of the blue.
I figured you'd appreciate it more that way. Glad you look okay.
I'll head out soon. You should be resting.
You don't need to worry about me that much.
Of course I do. You're the one who's sick.
It is. Besides, I don't think you should make your girlfriend worry so much.
(I need to get better soon, for ▲小早川＊▲'s sake too.)
(I'm so bored... I'm tired of just sitting around at home.)
Hehe, I came to see you.
I was just sitting around bored. I'm glad you came.
Hangin' in there. I feel a lot better now.
Sorry, I stayed too long. I'll head home now.
Yeah, thanks. I really appreciate it.
Anything else you need help with？ Like housework.
Uh, I'm good on that. I can manage.
...Quit looking so worried. If things get really bad, just call me. See ya.
(I need to get better soon, for ▲小早川＊▲'s sake too.)
Hey, am I in the way？
No way. I'm happy you came.
Man, the perks of being your boyfriend.
You're a lucky guy, having a sweet girlfriend who visits you when you're sick.
Yeah, ● is one lucky guy. I have no regrets left...
Huh？ Doesn't that make you feel sad？
Nope. If it came to that, I'd kick you and ask what you think you're doing leaving me behind.
Hey, is there anything you want to do？
Don't give me that. Save that stuff for when you're better.
If you don't like it, hurry up and get better.
Thanks for coming to see me. I'm back on my feet thanks to you.
Huh, that's a pretty lukewarm reaction.
I'm in a bad mood from being bored while you were sick. Better fix it fast.
I'm completely recovered thanks to you. Bet I could even dodge your kicks now.
You have to make up for all the time you were sick and pay attention to me!
I'm all better now. All thanks to your visit, ▲小早川＊▲.
Hehe, nice. Then take me on a date to pay me back.
Yeah, good idea. Let's see, what should we do...
Hey, hey, when should we go？
